purpose: Expand selected from-scratch language material from twelve training books to millions of words of authored prose.
policy: Only the selected Gutenberg editions enter training. Founders use random weights and fixed byte IDs. Held-out books never provide learning, replay or teacher targets. The code MIT license does not relicense source books.
stage_note: Stages group elementary readers, shorter narratives, sustained adventures and longer novels. They are content organization, not human ages or validated mastery. A separate schedule must declare exposure.
edition_note: Historical English editions and translations, including fiction, dated vocabulary and social assumptions. No claim of modern factual accuracy. Raw source notices and catalogue pages remain cached. Sample review is not an exhaustive reading.

stages.name: Shorter narratives
stages.focus: Dialogue and connected events in shorter stories.

stages.name: Sustained narratives and explanations
stages.focus: Longer passages, descriptions and changing situations.

stages.name: Longer novels
stages.focus: Extended narrative, dialogue and richer sentence structure.
